context: Planning counterexample: consequential-assumption guidance must not invent discovery gates or reopen established feasibility.

checklist.name: One ready issue
checklist.description: Drafts one cohesive issue, without a parent hierarchy, blocking spike, discovery phase, or separate code/docs/test tickets

checklist.name: Settled proof reused
checklist.description: Uses the existing alias capability and passing current-base contract tests without requiring another feasibility investigation or renewed approval

checklist.name: Acceptance preserves decisions
checklist.description: Captures the new and old names, one-release compatibility, warning, new-key precedence, documentation, and relevant compatibility tests

checklist.name: Changed behavior still verified
checklist.description: Retains verification of the actual rename and precedence behavior rather than treating existing loader tests as proof the future change is complete

checklist.name: Draft scope held
checklist.description: Does not publish, implement, create a second backlog, or claim the change is already delivered
